record_scope_reconstruction: February20–23,2024 intermittent farmer action at Kalpaki inland road junction serving Greek Kakavia and Mertzani customs approaches. It did not establish simultaneous closure at both international gates. Buses/vulnerable travelers and temporary openings were permitted, and nearby detours had their own short restrictions.

source_checks.finding: Full ERT report inspected: Kalpaki road to Kakavia/Mertzani closed from10:00 with a one-hour opening, buses/vulnerable groups permitted, later one-hour detour restrictions announced.
Full CNN report inspected: police stopped tractors at Kalpaki junction, later sit-in blocked road toward Kakavia/Konitsa.
Full EpirusPost report inspected: junction blocked for hours, Kakavia and Konitsa traffic redirected via bypasses.
Full later EpirusPost report inspected: continuing daily symbolic Kalpaki blocks make Kakavia access difficult; no observed final reopening inferred.

Indexed February22 report inspected: police road measures locate Kalpaki junction at33rd km of Ioannina–Konitsa–Kakavia road; heavy vehicles also held at29th km. Additional29th-km site not assigned without coordinates.
